assistant|falafel_crispy_tip: Use dry chickpeas soaked overnight and drained well to remove excess moisture

assistant|falafel_fluffy_tip: Don't over-mix chickpeas with spices and herbs to avoid dense falafel
Use egg, breadcrumbs, and/or oats as binding agents without making mixture too dense
